description: Exports the full building data as JSON that can be restored from the website settings page. Use before bulk changes. The response is the exact backup JSON the website restore accepts and can be large.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

name: backup_building
title: Back up building
